evals.name: explicit_date_required
evals.prompt: 把最近快速 capture 都正式整理一下。
evals.expected_output: Do not run audit, status, or start-batch until the user supplies one explicit local study date.
expectations: No date is inferred from UTC receipts, mtimes, Git diff, or chat memory.
No formal write occurs.
Only the minimum date blocker is returned.

evals.name: freeze_exact_ordered_set
evals.prompt: 正式编纂 2026-08-04 的快速捕获。
evals.expected_output: Audit, inspect status, and start one batch that freezes the exact ordered capture IDs, attempt, batch ID, and capture-set SHA-256 for 2026-08-04.
expectations: Only authorized awaiting captures for that date enter the set.
Same-day captures added later are excluded.
The frozen order is immutable.

evals.name: consumer_exactly_once
evals.prompt: 冻结批次每题都尝试读取 Luna 报告。
evals.expected_output: Call ~/.codex/study-intake-preprocessor/current/bin/preprocess_consumer.py consume exactly once per frozen item with the exact date, capture, batch, and set hash.
expectations: Only the current immutable release consumer is used.
No worker wake, retry, backfill, or poll occurs.
Every consumer status has formal_write_count zero.

evals.name: luna_status_matrix_fail_soft
evals.prompt: 本批次 Luna 状态可能是 ready、single_pass_degraded、absent、stale、failed、disabled 或 timeout。
evals.expected_output: Use only ready plus two_pass_ready with gpt-5.6-luna and reasoning_effort max; treat degraded and every other status as no-report and continue immediately from raw capture and direct evidence without waiting.
expectations: Both analysis and critical_review receipts must be ready Luna Max.
A single-stage result is only a recovery checkpoint.
No status authorizes a formal write.

evals.name: reopen_raw_capture_and_bundle
evals.prompt: 处理冻结 CAP-1，先核对事实源。
evals.expected_output: Reopen the exact raw capture, recompute payload hash, and verify the current-question-evidence-bundle-v3 manifest, object hash, permissions, source/date/context binding, question mode, ordered roles, actual image magic, and trace v2 disclosure.
expectations: Missing image roles are evidence_pending with zero model calls.
A ninth image, corrupt bytes, or declared/detected mismatch fails closed.
Legacy captures are marked legacy_evidence rather than upgraded.

evals.name: reject_drifted_report_continue_raw
evals.prompt: Luna package 的 batch、set、payload、bundle、report hash、publication 或权威回执有一个不匹配。
evals.expected_output: Resolve the supplied preprocessor root to current, independently verify the current release HMAC authority chain, quarantine any mismatch as rejected_report, discard all Luna claims, and continue from valid raw evidence.
expectations: Self-declared authority_verified is never trusted.
The authority frozen input fingerprint and critical-review revised report must match the Luna package and report.
The invalid report cannot block or authorize formal work.

evals.name: sol_field_level_decisions
evals.prompt: Luna v2 给出了正式编纂候选。
evals.expected_output: Create content-addressed sol_curation_decision_v1 and record Luna value, Sol adopt/modify/reject, direct evidence, basis, counterevidence, confidence, and unresolved gaps for every candidate claim.
expectations: Sol does not copy the report wholesale.
Only capture/bundle evidence refs are accepted.
The approved canonical package is answer-safe.

evals.name: immutable_conflict_needs_user
evals.prompt: Luna 与原始题证对学习日期、真实作答或提示依赖有冲突。
evals.expected_output: Keep the direct immutable fact unresolved, return needs_user, and perform zero formal preflight or apply.
expectations: Luna cannot vote over user facts.
The exact answer-safe conflict is retained.
Later independent items may continue when safe.

evals.name: strict_serial_formal_writes
evals.prompt: 冻结批次有 CAP-1 和 CAP-2。
evals.expected_output: Complete CAP-1 identity, preflight, one apply, full postcommit, mark-result, and terminal binding before starting CAP-2 formal preflight/apply.
expectations: Formal batch size is 1.
The second apply timestamp is after the first terminal.
Failures stay visible and are not omitted from totals.

evals.name: new_and_redo_identity
evals.prompt: CAP-1 是新题，CAP-2 是 redo。
evals.expected_output: Keep the new package formal_id null with auto_id true until RepoLock allocation, and require one verified existing formal ID for redo.
expectations: Neither Luna nor Sol reserves a new ID.
Identity ambiguity yields needs_user.
No duplicate formal node is created.

evals.name: receipt_bound_closeout_only
evals.prompt: 一题已有 normal receipt，但 postcommit 没完成。
evals.expected_output: Resume closeout with the original receipt and never replay the successful formal apply.
expectations: The receipt and WAL bind the same approved package.
mark-result waits for full closeout.
A fake receipt is rejected.

evals.name: already_current_no_fake_receipt
evals.prompt: 一题经核验正式库已经完全一致。
evals.expected_output: Record already_current with formal ID and exact verification SHA-256, not a fabricated normal receipt.
expectations: Verification binds batch, set, payload, bundle, decision, and repository state.
Apply count is zero.
Terminal binding reopens the exact item-result line.

evals.name: adoption_observability_only
evals.prompt: 正式事务成功，但 sol_adoption_receipt_v2 写入失败。
evals.expected_output: Keep the formal terminal committed and report an observability failure without rollback, replay, or status confusion.
expectations: Adoption is recorded only after exact terminal binding.
It binds all required hashes when successful.
It is never formal completion truth.

evals.name: minimal_next_morning_closeout
evals.prompt: 本批次全部达到终态并通过全局验收，准备明早。
evals.expected_output: Close the exact batch, then prepare the next queue/pack sidecar bound only to queue, review-ledger cutoff, current sources, builder/schema, and author/verifier receipts.
expectations: No personalization corpus, cross activation, personalization index, recommendation, or variant demand is rebuilt.
Preparation failure does not reopen the formal batch.
Old pack/session/capture/Luna-v1/adoption-v1 objects remain read-only.
